# Exact Sciences

[Woman relaxing at sunset.]
Introducing

## Cancerguard^{®}

Our innovative multi-cancer early detection test.
We're united by a shared purpose: helping people live fuller lives through better health. Together,
we will transform the way cancer is detected, diagnosed and managed for more people around the
world.
[Exact Sciences is now ABBOTT.]
[Lab technician examining a test sample on a microscope slide.]
We’re fighting cancer every step of the way
[A smiling patient hugging a caregiver.]
So that everyone feels confident about their path forward

## ## We help bring clarity to cancer

Cancer creates so many uncertainties. We’re committed to answering questions, solving problems, and
making a lasting, positive impact on people's lives. Our tests explore hereditary risks, screen for
cancer’s presence, and examine the unique genomic alterations of an individual’s cancer after a
diagnosis to help guide their treatment.

## Everything starts with people

We’re focused on patients, providers, doctors, researchers, and caregivers. Our medical experts
partner with the industry’s best minds and collaborate with top institutions, advocacy partners, and
policymakers to help change lives and transform how the world approaches cancer.
[A woman named Deepa smiling.]

## A breast cancer surgeon's breast cancer journey

Hear how genomic testing helped Deepa and her doctor make an informed decision to forgo
chemotherapy.^{[*][15]}
[oncotype DX Breast Recurrence Score logo.]
[A woman named Leigh Anne smiling.]

## Convenient testing made early detection easy

Watch how testing at home helped Leigh Anne take the first step in diagnosing and treating her colon
cancer before it progressed.
[Cologuard by Exact Sciences logo.]
[Two Exact Sciences technicians working with lab equipment.]

## Fueling breakthroughs in cancer care

Our experience and process set us apart. Life-changing science. Deep expertise. Strong
collaboration. State-of-the-art labs. Rigorous research. The result? Proven accuracy, better
potential outcomes, and continuous progress in the fight against cancer.
[Two Exact Sciences technicians working with lab equipment.]

## Putting big ideas into action

Discover our DNA through our latest announcements and stories.
[Colorectal cancer survivors uniting at the Cologuard Classic by Exact Sciences.]

## The Power in Numbers

Colorectal cancer survivors unite at the Cologuard Classic by Exact Sciences to celebrate their
triumphs, build community

## Become part of something meaningful

Changing lives and achieving our purpose starts with our team and their commitment to fighting
cancer. Are you ready to make a difference? Explore open positions and learn why Exact Sciences has
been a certified Great Place To Work^{®} for seven years running
[Three Exact Sciences' associates collaborating in the Wisconsin headquarters' atrium.]
[An Exact Sciences associate writing on a white board while her colleagues look on.]
[An Exact Sciences customer representative smiling and talking on a phone headset.]

## Get in touch

Questions or comments? Find customer support, company contacts, and location information all in one
place.

## Footnotes
1. In addition to being an Oncotype DX^{®} Ambassador, Deepa occasionally serves in a professional
   capacity as a paid consultant of Exact Sciences. These services are unrelated to this activity.
1. Diergaarde B, Young G, Hall DW, et al. Circulating tumor DNA as a marker of recurrence risk in
   stage III colorectal cancer: the α-CORRECT study. *J Surg Oncol*. Jan 2025. (Suppl). doi:
   10.1002/jso.27989

# Exact Sciences

[Woman relaxing at sunset.]
Introducing

## Cancerguard^{®}

Our innovative multi-cancer early detection test.
We're united by a shared purpose: helping people live fuller lives through better health. Together,
we will transform the way cancer is detected, diagnosed and managed for more people around the
world.
[Exact Sciences is now ABBOTT.]
[Lab technician examining a test sample on a microscope slide.]
We’re fighting cancer every step of the way
[A smiling patient hugging a caregiver.]
So that everyone feels confident about their path forward

## ## We help bring clarity to cancer

Cancer creates so many uncertainties. We’re committed to answering questions, solving problems, and
making a lasting, positive impact on people's lives. Our tests explore hereditary risks, screen for
cancer’s presence, and examine the unique genomic alterations of an individual’s cancer after a
diagnosis to help guide their treatment.

## Everything starts with people

We’re focused on patients, providers, doctors, researchers, and caregivers. Our medical experts
partner with the industry’s best minds and collaborate with top institutions, advocacy partners, and
policymakers to help change lives and transform how the world approaches cancer.
[A woman named Deepa smiling.]

## A breast cancer surgeon's breast cancer journey

Hear how genomic testing helped Deepa and her doctor make an informed decision to forgo
chemotherapy.^{[*][15]}
[oncotype DX Breast Recurrence Score logo.]
[A woman named Leigh Anne smiling.]

## Convenient testing made early detection easy

Watch how testing at home helped Leigh Anne take the first step in diagnosing and treating her colon
cancer before it progressed.
[Cologuard by Exact Sciences logo.]
[Two Exact Sciences technicians working with lab equipment.]

## Fueling breakthroughs in cancer care

Our experience and process set us apart. Life-changing science. Deep expertise. Strong
collaboration. State-of-the-art labs. Rigorous research. The result? Proven accuracy, better
potential outcomes, and continuous progress in the fight against cancer.
[Two Exact Sciences technicians working with lab equipment.]

## Putting big ideas into action

Discover our DNA through our latest announcements and stories.
[Colorectal cancer survivors uniting at the Cologuard Classic by Exact Sciences.]

## The Power in Numbers

Colorectal cancer survivors unite at the Cologuard Classic by Exact Sciences to celebrate their
triumphs, build community

## Become part of something meaningful

Changing lives and achieving our purpose starts with our team and their commitment to fighting
cancer. Are you ready to make a difference? Explore open positions and learn why Exact Sciences has
been a certified Great Place To Work^{®} for seven years running
[Three Exact Sciences' associates collaborating in the Wisconsin headquarters' atrium.]
[An Exact Sciences associate writing on a white board while her colleagues look on.]
[An Exact Sciences customer representative smiling and talking on a phone headset.]

## Get in touch

Questions or comments? Find customer support, company contacts, and location information all in one
place.

## Footnotes
1. In addition to being an Oncotype DX^{®} Ambassador, Deepa occasionally serves in a professional
   capacity as a paid consultant of Exact Sciences. These services are unrelated to this activity.
1. Diergaarde B, Young G, Hall DW, et al. Circulating tumor DNA as a marker of recurrence risk in
   stage III colorectal cancer: the α-CORRECT study. *J Surg Oncol*. Jan 2025. (Suppl). doi:
   10.1002/jso.27989

## Explore the latest from Labcorp

### REAL-WORLD DATA PLATFORM

#### AI‑powered real‑world data platform for Alzheimer's disease

Developed with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Datavant, Labcorp’s AI-powered platform delivers
longitudinal laboratory data at scale with advanced analytics to accelerate discovery, streamline
drug development, and improve patient outcomes.

[ Learn More ][211]
[Read Press Release][212]
[Mother and daughter embracing themselves with smiles on their faces]

### MyLabcorp mobile app

#### My results, trends, and more, all in MyLabcorp.

Staying on top of your health just got easier. MyLabcorp is our AI-powered app that helps explain
your Labcorp test results, tracks your trends over time, and lets you manage appointments and
billing, in one place.

[ Learn More ][213]
[Read Press Release][214]
[Patient using MyLabcorp application on their phone]

### Test Finder

#### Plain language, smarter support: AI that speaks clinician

Labcorp's AI-enhanced Test Finder, a first-of-its-kind conversational search tool, is now integrated
into EHRs using [Labcorp Diagnostic Assistant™][215] and available through EHR companion platform
[Labcorp Link™][216], enabling seamless and intuitive test search at the point of care. 

[ View Test Finder ][217]
[Read Press Release][218]

Genetic Insights

### Invitae joins Labcorp

Labcorp welcomes the Invitae team, scientific leaders and pioneers in the development and adoption
of genetic testing.

[ Learn More ][219]

Data Solutions

### Leading with Lab Data

Providers like Dr. Doron Schneider have the power to change lives. Our lab data has the answers to
empower them.

[ Learn More ][220]

Oncology

### Delivering insights that bring hope

Testing options like solid tissue biopsies and blood-based testing alternatives help clear the path
to better outcomes for patients. 

[ Learn More ][221]

Biopharma

### Scientifically rigorous, extensive in scale

Our global lab footprint, vast clinical data and scientific expertise help accelerate the drug
development process.

[ Learn More ][222]
[Labcorp biopharma technician evaluating samples]

Labcorp OnDemand

### Stop wondering. Go test yourself.

Explore over 50 self-ordered lab tests and get answers about your health.

[ Shop All Tests ][223]

#### AI‑powered real‑world data platform for Alzheimer's disease

Developed with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Datavant, Labcorp’s AI-powered platform delivers
longitudinal laboratory data at scale with advanced analytics to accelerate discovery, streamline
drug development, and improve patient outcomes.

[ Learn More ][211]

### MyLabcorp mobile app

#### My results, trends, and more, all in MyLabcorp.

Staying on top of your health just got easier. MyLabcorp is our AI-powered app that helps explain
your Labcorp test results, tracks your trends over time, and lets you manage appointments and
billing, in one place.

[ Learn More ][213]
[Read Press Release][214]

into EHRs using [Labcorp Diagnostic Assistant™][215] and available through EHR companion platform
[Labcorp Link™][216], enabling seamless and intuitive test search at the point of care.

## Testing specialties

### Gastroenterology

###### Gastroenterology

Our integration with a world-renowned medical center equips us with patient experience that supports
development of disease-specific, algorithmic-based testing approaches that provide faster answers
for each patient. Whether screening patients or monitoring therapeutic management, our evaluations
cover the full-spectrum of gastroenterology testing.

### Genetics

###### Genetics

Mayo Clinic Laboratories has been providing meaningful results to individuals seeking genetic
answers. Rare genetic disorders can be among the most difficult conditions to diagnose. To provide
meaningful answers, our genetic testing is developed and supported by an integrated team of
clinical, genetic, and laboratory experts and uses precision technologies to reveal variations
related to diagnosis and treatment. Built around a tradition of placing patients’ needs first, our
testing generates personalized insights to elevate understanding of a patient’s condition.

### Hematology

###### Hematology

Our comprehensive test menu has been created to aid in diagnosis and treatment selection across the
full spectrum of hematologic disorders. We have developed and validated practice-based, data-driven
algorithms that improve patient care, increase efficiency, and reduce costs. Our hematology experts
continuously drive innovation in laboratory testing, developing new approaches and using new
technology to address patient needs they see every day in clinical practice.

### Immunology

###### Immunology

Immunology testing at Mayo Clinic Laboratories is supported by a multidisciplinary team of experts
who apply the latest research to propel the development of meaningful assays. These tests are used
to assist with disease identification, monitoring of disease processes, and monitoring and treatment
of rare immunologic illnesses.

### Microbiology & Infectious Diseases

###### Microbiology & Infectious Diseases

Our internationally renowned clinical microbiology laboratories offer a broad selection of tests
designed for rapid identification and in-depth characterization of the causative agents of
infectious diseases. We have developed and implemented culture techniques, immunoassays,
antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and molecular methods for rapid detection, identification, and
characterization, as well as provision of treatment guidance for microbial pathogens.

### Neurology

###### Neurology

Mayo Clinic Laboratories is leading an evolution in neurology testing.

## Insights & News


###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

# We believe in the power of science to transform our world.

Together with scientists and operators worldwide, we empower progress by providing trusted insights
and services that accelerate work and amplify impact for a healthier, safer, and more sustainable
world.

[Biopharma][240] [Applied Solutions][241] [Food Solutions][242]


# We drive efficiency and empower sustainable scientific discovery with nearly 90 years of
# pioneering innovation.

[Discover More][243]


## By your side, globally.

Offices in 35 countries.

Customers served in 168 countries (direct and through distributors).

Manufacturing presence in North-America, Europe and APAC, incl. China.


## People power progress.

We believe great ideas can come from anywhere – because our customers rely on the ingenuity,
creativity, and passion of our people.

We’re on a mission to transform our world. Will you join us?

[Explore Careers][244]


## Conveniently find parts for your instrument and place orders with our new online store.

[Shop Now][245]

❯
 

## Insights & News


###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

Our focus is enabling the most innovative discovery, measurement, and testing solutions across our
strategic growth platforms.

## In the spotlight

[Roche publishes its first quarter results for 2026][103]

Roche reports 7% (CER) sales for the full year results in 2025. Commenting on the results, CEO
Thomas Schinecker said: “2025 was a strong year for Roche, reflecting our continued focus on
operational and R&D excellence.”

[How we improved outcomes for patients around the world][104]

With our combined strengths in Diagnostic and Pharmaceuticals, we worked to provide real and
positive change for patients, the people they love and the professionals who care for them. Discover
the highlights in our Annual Report.

Guided by the experiences of patients, we are determined to prevent, stop and cure diseases so
people can live healthier, longer lives.

Online doctor consultations take place through online doctor chat, call, or video call. This helps
you to talk to doctors online from the comfort of your home by simply choosing a doctor from
different specialties. Avail personalised solutions for any health problem with prompt online doctor
consultation with Apollo 24|7.
* Safe and secure platform
* Video and chat options

**Online Doctor Consultation - Now at Your Fingertips**
The demand for doctors is expected to increase as new medicines allow people to live longer.
However, there are several ways to reach out to a doctor without the need to visit a hospital or
clinic, all thanks to technology. With the online facility available, doctor consultations have
become easier, and you can get the right health care. Online doctor consultations with 5000+ top
medical doctors are available at Apollo 24|7. Video call or chat with expert doctors from 100+
medical specialties, including | [Dermatology][99] | [Gynaecology][100] | [Paediatrics][101] |
[Psychiatry][102] | [General Physicians][103] | [Gastroenterology][104] | [Dietetics][105] | [Ent
Specialists][106] | and more, in just 15 minutes.

Benefits of choosing online doctor consultations:
* Save time, money, and effort.
* No need to travel. 
* Most convenient option to choose from, and helps in early diagnosis.
* Online doctor consultations are confidential and safe.
* No risks of infections.

## **Apollo Hospitals**

Apollo 24|7 is a part of Apollo Hospitals. [Apollo Hospitals][107] was established in 1983 by Dr.
Prathap C Reddy. It incorporates over 10,000 beds across 70 hospitals, over 4000 pharmacies, 172
primary care and diagnostic clinics, and 148 telemedicine facilities spread across 13 countries.
Apollo Hospitals has touched billions of lives by offering exceptional clinical outcomes.

Milestones of Apollo Hospitals:
* 40 Years of legacy and credibility in the healthcare industry. 
* NABL certified multi-channel digital healthcare platform.
* World’s best medical specialists.
* Largest & trusted branded healthcare network.
* Advanced healthcare technology.
   

**Pharmacy Simplified with Apollo 24|7**
Apollo pharmacy is the most credible and established online pharmacy in India. It delivers 100%
original medicines and products. Apollo pharmacy is believed to offer super-fast home delivery for
all the healthcare essentials. Explore our broad range of  products such as baby care, personal
care, wellness, lifestyle, health, and nutrition categories online with ease. 

Rapid deliveries of medicines are available online at Apollo Pharmacy. In some cities, deliveries
are done in less than 24 hours.
* Get health credits on purchasing medicines and products.
* Alluring deals on medicines and other products.
* A broad range of medicines and essential healthcare products to choose from.
* Authentic and top-notch quality products.

## Supporting Ebola Response: Rapid Diagnostics and Global Expertise

Advancing our commitment to public health, our teams are partnering to actively support Ebola
response efforts on the ground, expand diagnostic testing and strengthen laboratory capabilities.

[ Explore the Ebola Resource Hub ][207]

## Protecting Food. Protecting People.

Safe food isn't just a privilege; it is a necessity. An estimated 600 million people fall ill after
eating contaminated food annually, with approximately 420,000 losing their lives. Efficient,
reliable and fast diagnostic solutions play a crucial role in safety, quality and protecting
consumers worldwide.

[ Discover Food & Quality Safety Solutions ][208]

## Annual Report: Achievements Building a Healthier Future

bioMérieux’s Annual Report highlights the achievements shaping public health, innovation, and
environmental responsibility for our future. From strengthening the fight against AMR and sepsis to
accelerating sustainable solutions, our work continues driving better outcomes for people, our
communities and the planet.

[ Explore the 2025 Annual Report ][209]

  ## Gastrointestinal Panels to enhance detection of gastrointestinal pathogens ][213]
  
  bioMérieux, a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics, today announces the submission of
  the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY® Gastrointestinal 1.1 (GI1.1) Panel and the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY®
  Gastrointestinal 1.1 (GI1.1) Panel Mid to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for 510(k)

  viruses, and parasites associated with gastroenteritis, all from one sample, with results
  available in approximately one hour.

  Waiver application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the BIOFIRE® SPOTFIRE®
  Vaginitis (VG) Panel. This automated, multiplex PCR test can simultaneously detect the most common
  causes of vaginitis in 20 minutes, directly at the point of care. With this submission, bioMérieux

## Supporting Ebola Response: Rapid Diagnostics and Global Expertise

Advancing our commitment to public health, our teams are partnering to actively support Ebola
response efforts on the ground, expand diagnostic testing and strengthen laboratory capabilities.

## Protecting Food. Protecting People.

Safe food isn't just a privilege; it is a necessity. An estimated 600 million people fall ill after
eating contaminated food annually, with approximately 420,000 losing their lives. Efficient,
reliable and fast diagnostic solutions play a crucial role in safety, quality and protecting
consumers worldwide.

[ Discover Food & Quality Safety Solutions ][208]

## Annual Report: Achievements Building a Healthier Future

bioMérieux’s Annual Report highlights the achievements shaping public health, innovation, and
environmental responsibility for our future. From strengthening the fight against AMR and sepsis to
accelerating sustainable solutions, our work continues driving better outcomes for people, our
communities and the planet.

* ## [ bioMérieux submits 510(k) to U.S. FDA for the latest versions of the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY®
  ## Gastrointestinal Panels to enhance detection of gastrointestinal pathogens ][213]
  
  bioMérieux, a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics, today announces the submission of
  the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY® Gastrointestinal 1.1 (GI1.1) Panel and the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY®
  Gastrointestinal 1.1 (GI1.1) Panel Mid to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for 510(k)

  viruses, and parasites associated with gastroenteritis, all from one sample, with results
  available in approximately one hour.

* ## [ Advancing Women’s Health with Rapid Diagnostics: bioMérieux files a Dual 510(k) /CLIA Waiver
  ## application to the FDA for the BIOFIRE® SPOTFIRE® Vaginitis Panel ][215]
  
  bioMérieux, a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics, has submitted a Dual 510(k)/CLIA
  Waiver application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the BIOFIRE® SPOTFIRE®
  Vaginitis (VG) Panel. This automated, multiplex PCR test can simultaneously detect the most common
  causes of vaginitis in 20 minutes, directly at the point of care. With this submission, bioMérieux
  is intending to expand into women’s and sexual health, bringing rapid and accurate diagnostics
  closer to patients.

## NHS Right to Choose

If you're an NHS patient in England, you have the legal right to choose the service or hospital that
provides your physical and mental health care. This means that if your GP refers you for mental
health treatment, in most cases, you can choose the provider that best suits your needs.

[ NHS Right to Choose services ][111]

Enquire today

next steps.

[0203 326 9160][113]

Clinical Partners is not a crisis service. If you or someone you know needs urgent help, speak to

Custom corporate wellness programs for your employees. On-site biometric screenings, blood testing,
and reporting.

### About Complete Mobile Health

Complete Mobile Health is a trusted leader in onsite wellness and medical testing services, proudly
serving businesses for over a decade. Our team of experienced healthcare professionals is dedicated
to bringing high-quality, convenient, and reliable testing solutions directly to your workplace.

Founded with the mission of making employee health and safety more accessible, we specialize in
mobile services that reduce downtime, increase participation, and ensure compliance with
occupational health standards. Whether it’s drug and alcohol testing, biometric screenings, flu
shots, or full wellness events—we come to you, fully equipped and ready to serve.

With years of hands-on experience in the industry, our staff understands the unique needs of
businesses across various sectors. From small offices to large industrial sites, we provide tailored
solutions that fit your operations and schedule. Our professionalism, efficiency, and commitment to
care set us apart in the mobile health space.

# Advocacy for People Living with Diabetes

Diabetes is the most expensive chronic condition in the U.S. and affects millions of families. This
Chronic Disease Awareness Month, help us continue advocating for people living with diabetes.

[ Donate Today ][150] [  Learn more ][151]

[Woman sitting, eyes closed, hand on forehead, looking distressed.]

the good fight

## It All Matters

We’ve learned in our 85 years that in the fight to end diabetes, everything matters. So this month,
we’re recognizing all those getting up alongside us and staying in the fight to end diabetes.

[play video]

## What's Happening?

Stay on top of what's new at the American Diabetes Association, diabetes-related updates, healthy
living resources, and more!

[
Image
[Graphic: US map showing state-level diabetes indicator. TX, CA, OH highest; ND, SD lowest.]
][159]
advocacy

### Advocate for Affordable Insulin Now

1 in 6 Americans ration insulin due to cost. Support the Insulin Act, critical, bipartisan
legislation that will make insulin more affordable and accessible for millions.

[ Sign the Petition ][160]
[
Image
[Smiling family of four wearing shirts that say "Diabetes Warrior" and "Beat Diabetes."]
][161]
SHOP DIABETES

### Save up to 25% off on official ADA merchandise

Save up to 25% on official American Diabetes Association® (ADA) merchandise! Shop T-shirts, along
with other apparel, accessories, and ADA gear. Prices are as marked.

[ Shop Now ][162]
[
Image
[Smiling African American woman in workout gear]
][163]
Diabetes Prevention

### Take Steps to Prevent Type 2 Diabetes

Understanding your risk and taking early action are key steps for diabetes prevention. Explore
expert-backed tools and programs to help you lower your risk for type 2 diabetes. 

[ I Can Do It ][164]
[
Image
[American Diabetes Association Scientific Sessions 2026 logo]
][165]
meetings

### 2026 Scientific Sessions

Register for on-demand access to content from the 2026 Scientific Sessions, available through August
10. Watch presentations on your schedule and earn up to 240+ CME/CE credits.

[ Register Now ][166]
[
Image
[Diabetes Technology Meeting DTM 2026]
][167]
MEETINGS

### Diabetes Technology Meeting

Explore breakthroughs in CGM, AI, and diabetes devices at the 2026 Diabetes Technology Meeting (DTM)
in Washington, DC.

[ Register Today ][168]
[
Image
[Three smiling girls in orange helmets and harnesses at an ADA diabetes day camp.]
][169]
camp

### ADA Camp Registration is Open

Explore our camp experiences designed to build confidence, independence, and connection—while
creating friendships and memories that last a lifetime. 

[ Learn More ][170]
[
Image
[Old photograph of American Diabetes Association founders]
][171]
about us

### 85 Years of Progress

Since 1940, the ADA^{ }has been a relentless force for progress—advocating, educating, and funding
groundbreaking research.

[ Learn More ][172]
[
Image
[ate_resource_card_whats_happening]
][173]
Ask the Experts

### Your Diabetes Questions Answered

Ask the Experts helps people living with diabetes tackle commonly faced issues by providing a
community where you can put your questions to our diabetes experts on a variety of topics.

[ Learn More ][174]
[
Image
[Heavy set woman on treadmill]
][175]
Take Action

### Access to Obesity Treatment

More than 50 percent of new cases of diabetes every year are linked to obesity. 
 

[ Learn More ][176]
[
Image
[Two people on a podcast]
][177]
Podcasts

### Diabetes Day by Day

A podcast for people with diabetes and their caregivers, listen in for practical advice on
overcoming everyday challenges of living with diabetes.

[ Listen to Diabetes Day by Day ][178]
[
Image
[African American woman preparing salad in kitchen]
][179]
Meal Planning

### Control Your Meals

Get tools to help with diabetes and kidney-friendly meal planning.

[ Shop Now ][180]

## Diabetes By-the-Numbers

The numbers are staggering. Diabetes isn't just a disease—it's an epidemic, affecting over 40
million Americans with devastating consequences.

1.5M

Americans are diagnosed each year

12%

of Americans had diabetes in 2023

115+M

American adults are living with prediabetes

But there's hope. Join us as we continue the fight to end diabetes and work to find a cure.

[ Become a Diabetes Advocate ][181] [ Share Your Story ][182]
[
Image
[Photo of Alex Park with her diabetes tech visible. ]
][183]

### Meet Alex

Learn how Alexandra Park manages her type 1 diabetes while busy as an actress, writer, and
producer! 

[ Read Her Story ][184]
[
Image
[Photo of Alex Park with her diabetes tech visible. ]
][185]

### Meet Alex

Learn how Alexandra Park manages her type 1 diabetes while busy as an actress, writer, and
producer! 

[ Read Her Story ][186]

## Are you at risk?

Learning your risk is the first step in taking action against type 2 diabetes. Take our 60-Second
Type 2 Diabetes Risk Test today to receive actionable next steps in your health journey.

[ Take the Test ][187]

Whether you're newly diagnosed, have been living with type 1 for years, or are helping out a loved

# Advocacy for People Living with Diabetes

Diabetes is the most expensive chronic condition in the U.S. and affects millions of families. This
Chronic Disease Awareness Month, help us continue advocating for people living with diabetes.

[ Donate Today ][150] [  Learn more ][151]

## It All Matters

We’ve learned in our 85 years that in the fight to end diabetes, everything matters. So this month,
we’re recognizing all those getting up alongside us and staying in the fight to end diabetes.

[play video]

## What's Happening?

Stay on top of what's new at the American Diabetes Association, diabetes-related updates, healthy
living resources, and more!

[
Image
[Graphic: US map showing state-level diabetes indicator. TX, CA, OH highest; ND, SD lowest.]
][159]
advocacy

### Advocate for Affordable Insulin Now

1 in 6 Americans ration insulin due to cost. Support the Insulin Act, critical, bipartisan
legislation that will make insulin more affordable and accessible for millions.

[ Sign the Petition ][160]
[
Image
[Smiling family of four wearing shirts that say "Diabetes Warrior" and "Beat Diabetes."]
][161]

### Save up to 25% off on official ADA merchandise

Save up to 25% on official American Diabetes Association® (ADA) merchandise! Shop T-shirts, along
with other apparel, accessories, and ADA gear. Prices are as marked.

[ Shop Now ][162]

Image
[Smiling African American woman in workout gear]
][163]
Diabetes Prevention

### Take Steps to Prevent Type 2 Diabetes

Understanding your risk and taking early action are key steps for diabetes prevention. Explore
expert-backed tools and programs to help you lower your risk for type 2 diabetes. 

[ I Can Do It ][164]

Register for on-demand access to content from the 2026 Scientific Sessions, available through August
10. Watch presentations on your schedule and earn up to 240+ CME/CE credits.

[ Register Now ][166]

in Washington, DC.

Explore our camp experiences designed to build confidence, independence, and connection—while
creating friendships and memories that last a lifetime.

### 85 Years of Progress

Since 1940, the ADA^{ }has been a relentless force for progress—advocating, educating, and funding
groundbreaking research.

[ Learn More ][172]

### Your Diabetes Questions Answered

Ask the Experts helps people living with diabetes tackle commonly faced issues by providing a
community where you can put your questions to our diabetes experts on a variety of topics.

[ Learn More ][174]
[

[Heavy set woman on treadmill]
][175]
Take Action

### Access to Obesity Treatment

More than 50 percent of new cases of diabetes every year are linked to obesity. 
 

[ Learn More ][176]

A podcast for people with diabetes and their caregivers, listen in for practical advice on

Get tools to help with diabetes and kidney-friendly meal planning.

The numbers are staggering. Diabetes isn't just a disease—it's an epidemic, affecting over 40
million Americans with devastating consequences.

1.5M

Americans are diagnosed each year

12%

of Americans had diabetes in 2023

115+M

American adults are living with prediabetes

But there's hope. Join us as we continue the fight to end diabetes and work to find a cure.

# Let’s get more people screened and protected.

Screening can detect cancer at an early stage. This toolkit will help you to support and encourage
more people to get screened and get early treatment if required.

Search for:

## Areas we support

### Breast

Together we can help more people access screening for the most common type of cancer in the UK.

[Read More][14]

### Bowel

Early symptoms of bowel cancer are hard to spot. Home screening can detect if something is present
in the test that may require further investigation, helping people to detect bowel cancer early and
get early treatment.

[Read More][15]

### Cervical

Cervical screening saves lives. Screening can detect changes in cells before they turn into cancer.

[Read More][16]

## Cheshire & Merseyside Statistics

###### There are 2.5 million people living in Cheshire and Merseyside
* ## 7,000
  
  cancer deaths in Cheshire and Merseyside every year. 290 people in every 100,000.
* ## 16,000
  
  people in Cheshire and Merseyside are diagnosed with cancer every year which is higher than the
  England average.
* ## 62.3%
  
  of the Cheshire and Merseyside population, age 70-74 years, completed and returned a bowel
  screening kit during 2020.
* ## 250,000
  
  women aged 50-70 have attended breast screening appointments in the past three years – that’s
  70.5% of the eligible population.
* ## 108,000
  
  women aged 25-39 screened attended a cervical screening appointment in the past five and half
  years in Cheshire and Merseyside – that’s 75% of the eligible population.

## Why is cancer screening important?

Catching cancer early saves lives. If we can detect it and start treatment early, it’s more likely
to work – and more people will survive. Screening is always a choice, and any aspect of the
screening process can be discussed with a health professional to enable an informed decision to be
made.

### Breast screening invitations

Invitations are sent every three years to women, some transgender men and some non-binary people
aged 50-71 (does not apply to 71+) who are registered with a GP.

### Bowel screening kits

All people aged 60-74 (now including 56 and 58-year-olds as of April 2021) registered with a GP are
sent a home screening kit every two years. If 75 years and over you can request a kit every two
years by phoning [0800 707 60 60][17].

### Cervical screening invitations

Invitations are sent to women, some transgender men and some non-binary people who are registered
with a GP. Every three years for 25–49-year-olds and every five years for 50–64-year-olds.

Early Detect Early Protect are positioned to provide resources to community health professionals and
encourage cancer screening to those who may be vulnerable.

# Autism assessments

We offer autism/AuDHD assessments for adults (18+)
completed by autistic and AuDHD psychologists with
expertise in high-masking presentations of autism.

## We offer 2 assessment pathways:

### Screening

For some people, the autism screening provides the clarity they were seeking,
and so they may choose not to continue
to a formal diagnosis.
Provides clarity.

### Screening
### + Formal diagnosis

For others, a full assessment and differential diagnosis are desired. If you choose to continue,
your screening becomes the foundation of your full diagnostic assessment.
Needed for workplace, school,
and disability accommodations.

process.] [Embrace Autism | Home | AssessmentProcess AutismScreening Green2]

HAMEDCO – Tiên phong giải pháp y tế công nghệ cao

## VỀ CHÚNG TÔI

Thành lập từ năm 2005, Công ty Cổ phần Vật tư và Thiết bị Y tế Hà Nội (HAMEDCO) đã khẳng định vị thế
vững chắc với hơn 20 năm kinh nghiệm trong ngành y tế. Đánh dấu bước ngoặt quan trọng vào năm 2022,
chúng tôi chính thức trở thành Nhà phân phối của Philips tại Việt Nam. Sự kết hợp giữa bề dày am
hiểu thị trường và công nghệ tiên tiến từ Philips giúp HAMEDCO cung cấp các hệ thống chẩn đoán hình
ảnh, giải pháp hồi sức cấp cứu vượt trội. Chúng tôi tập trung vào đội ngũ kỹ sư được đào tạo bài bản
và khắt khe, cam kết đồng hành cùng các bệnh viện để tối ưu vận hành, nâng cao độ chính xác trong
chẩn đoán và cải thiện chất lượng điều trị.

[Tìm hiểu thêm][25][Đối tác của chúng tôi][26]
[Philips EPIQ Elite - Máy siêu âm cao cấp]
Công nghệ Philips - Tiêu chuẩn bệnh viện
[Philips Logo]

## HAMEDCO - Nhà phân phối Philips Healthcare tại Việt Nam

Tự hào là nhà phân phối của Philips tại Việt Nam, HAMEDCO đồng hành đưa hệ sinh thái y khoa tiên
tiến cùng các giải pháp công nghệ hiện đại đến các bệnh viện và cơ sở y tế trên toàn quốc

### [HỆ THỐNG SIÊU ÂM][27]

Hệ thống siêu âm Philips cao cấp với chất lượng hình ảnh vượt trội và AI imaging tiên tiến. Hỗ trợ
chẩn đoán đa chuyên khoa với độ chính xác cao và hiệu quả lâm sàng tối ưu.

[Xem chi tiết][28]
[[Philips Ultrasound]][29]

### [HỆ THỐNG CHỤP CẮT LỚP VI TÍNH][30]

Hệ thống CT Scanner Philips (Chụp cắt lớp vi tính) tích hợp công nghệ hiện đại, tăng tốc quy trình
chẩn đoán. Mang đến hình ảnh sắc nét, tối ưu hiệu suất vận hành và ứng dụng lâm sàng chuyên sâu.

[Xem chi tiết][31]
[[Philips CT Scanner]][32]

### [HỆ THỐNG CHỤP CỘNG HƯỞNG TỪ][33]

Hệ thống MRI Philips 1.5T – 3.0T cho khả năng chẩn đoán chuyên sâu với chất lượng hình ảnh vượt
trội. Tối ưu trải nghiệm bệnh nhân, nâng cao hiệu quả vận hành và độ tin cậy lâm sàng.

[Xem chi tiết][34]
[[Philips MRI]][35]

### [HỆ THỐNG CHỤP X QUANG][36]

Hệ thống X-Quang Philips tiên tiến với hình ảnh chất lượng cao và workflow thông minh. Tích hợp AI
hỗ trợ vận hành, giảm liều tia và đáp ứng tiêu chuẩn bệnh viện hiện đại.

[Xem chi tiết][37]
[[Philips Digital Workflow]][38]
HỆ SINH THÁI DỊCH VỤ CHUYÊN NGHIỆP

## DỊCH VỤ CỦA CHÚNG TÔI

Giải pháp toàn diện cho bệnh viện và cơ sở y tế Đồng hành từ tư vấn, triển khai đến vận hành và bảo
trì — đảm bảo hệ thống thiết bị hoạt động tối ưu, dữ liệu đồng bộ và nâng cao hiệu quả đầu tư.

### Giải pháp phòng mổ hiện đại

Thiết kế và triển khai giải pháp phòng mổ tích hợp theo tiêu chuẩn quốc tế, bao gồm hệ thống thiết
bị, khí y tế, kiểm soát nhiễm khuẩn và quản lý dữ liệu. Giúp nâng cao hiệu quả phẫu thuật, đảm bảo
an toàn và tối ưu quy trình vận hành.

### Giải pháp chẩn đoán hình ảnh

Cung cấp giải pháp đồng bộ cho các hệ thống MRI, CT, DSA, siêu âm, từ lựa chọn cấu hình thiết bị, bố
trí không gian đến tích hợp vận hành. Đảm bảo chất lượng hình ảnh, độ chính xác chẩn đoán và hiệu
suất khai thác thiết bị.

### Giải pháp hồi sức cấp cứu & ICU

Xây dựng giải pháp thiết bị cho khoa hồi sức cấp cứu với hệ thống monitoring, máy thở, thiết bị hỗ
trợ sự sống… đáp ứng yêu cầu điều trị liên tục, chính xác và an toàn cho bệnh nhân.

### Giải pháp nâng cấp & tối ưu hệ thống

Đánh giá hiện trạng và đề xuất phương án nâng cấp, mở rộng hoặc tối ưu hệ thống thiết bị hiện có,
giúp cải thiện hiệu suất hoạt động, kéo dài vòng đời thiết bị và tối ưu chi phí đầu tư.

### Giải pháp tích hợp & chuyển đổi số

Tư vấn và triển khai các giải pháp tích hợp thiết bị với hệ thống quản lý bệnh viện (HIS, RIS,
PACS…), đảm bảo kết nối dữ liệu đồng bộ, hỗ trợ quản lý hiệu quả và nâng cao chất lượng dịch vụ y
tế.

### Giải pháp kỹ thuật & vận hành thiết bị chuyên sâu

Cung cấp giải pháp toàn diện trong quản lý, vận hành, bảo trì và tối ưu hiệu suất cho các hệ thống
thiết bị y tế, đặc biệt là thiết bị chẩn đoán hình ảnh. Đảm bảo thiết bị hoạt động ổn định, duy trì
độ chính xác và giảm thiểu rủi ro gián đoạn.

HÌNH ẢNH THỰC TẾ

Ảnh triển khai thực tế tại bệnh viện và sự kiện chuyên ngành — minh chứng năng lực tích hợp và đồng
hành của HAMEDCO.

## VỀ CHÚNG TÔI

Thành lập từ năm 2005, Công ty Cổ phần Vật tư và Thiết bị Y tế Hà Nội (HAMEDCO) đã khẳng định vị thế
vững chắc với hơn 20 năm kinh nghiệm trong ngành y tế. Đánh dấu bước ngoặt quan trọng vào năm 2022,
chúng tôi chính thức trở thành Nhà phân phối của Philips tại Việt Nam. Sự kết hợp giữa bề dày am
hiểu thị trường và công nghệ tiên tiến từ Philips giúp HAMEDCO cung cấp các hệ thống chẩn đoán hình
ảnh, giải pháp hồi sức cấp cứu vượt trội. Chúng tôi tập trung vào đội ngũ kỹ sư được đào tạo bài bản
và khắt khe, cam kết đồng hành cùng các bệnh viện để tối ưu vận hành, nâng cao độ chính xác trong
chẩn đoán và cải thiện chất lượng điều trị.

## DỊCH VỤ CỦA CHÚNG TÔI

Giải pháp toàn diện cho bệnh viện và cơ sở y tế Đồng hành từ tư vấn, triển khai đến vận hành và bảo
trì — đảm bảo hệ thống thiết bị hoạt động tối ưu, dữ liệu đồng bộ và nâng cao hiệu quả đầu tư.

### Giải pháp phòng mổ hiện đại

Thiết kế và triển khai giải pháp phòng mổ tích hợp theo tiêu chuẩn quốc tế, bao gồm hệ thống thiết
bị, khí y tế, kiểm soát nhiễm khuẩn và quản lý dữ liệu. Giúp nâng cao hiệu quả phẫu thuật, đảm bảo
an toàn và tối ưu quy trình vận hành.

### Giải pháp chẩn đoán hình ảnh

Cung cấp giải pháp đồng bộ cho các hệ thống MRI, CT, DSA, siêu âm, từ lựa chọn cấu hình thiết bị, bố
trí không gian đến tích hợp vận hành. Đảm bảo chất lượng hình ảnh, độ chính xác chẩn đoán và hiệu
suất khai thác thiết bị.

### Giải pháp hồi sức cấp cứu & ICU

Xây dựng giải pháp thiết bị cho khoa hồi sức cấp cứu với hệ thống monitoring, máy thở, thiết bị hỗ
trợ sự sống… đáp ứng yêu cầu điều trị liên tục, chính xác và an toàn cho bệnh nhân.

### Giải pháp nâng cấp & tối ưu hệ thống

Đánh giá hiện trạng và đề xuất phương án nâng cấp, mở rộng hoặc tối ưu hệ thống thiết bị hiện có,
giúp cải thiện hiệu suất hoạt động, kéo dài vòng đời thiết bị và tối ưu chi phí đầu tư.

### Giải pháp tích hợp & chuyển đổi số

Tư vấn và triển khai các giải pháp tích hợp thiết bị với hệ thống quản lý bệnh viện (HIS, RIS,
PACS…), đảm bảo kết nối dữ liệu đồng bộ, hỗ trợ quản lý hiệu quả và nâng cao chất lượng dịch vụ y
tế.

### Giải pháp kỹ thuật & vận hành thiết bị chuyên sâu

Cung cấp giải pháp toàn diện trong quản lý, vận hành, bảo trì và tối ưu hiệu suất cho các hệ thống
thiết bị y tế, đặc biệt là thiết bị chẩn đoán hình ảnh. Đảm bảo thiết bị hoạt động ổn định, duy trì
độ chính xác và giảm thiểu rủi ro gián đoạn.

## DỊCH VỤ CỦA CHÚNG TÔI

Giải pháp toàn diện cho bệnh viện và cơ sở y tế Đồng hành từ tư vấn, triển khai đến vận hành và bảo
trì — đảm bảo hệ thống thiết bị hoạt động tối ưu, dữ liệu đồng bộ và nâng cao hiệu quả đầu tư.

### Giải pháp phòng mổ hiện đại

Thiết kế và triển khai giải pháp phòng mổ tích hợp theo tiêu chuẩn quốc tế, bao gồm hệ thống thiết
bị, khí y tế, kiểm soát nhiễm khuẩn và quản lý dữ liệu. Giúp nâng cao hiệu quả phẫu thuật, đảm bảo
an toàn và tối ưu quy trình vận hành.

### Giải pháp chẩn đoán hình ảnh

Cung cấp giải pháp đồng bộ cho các hệ thống MRI, CT, DSA, siêu âm, từ lựa chọn cấu hình thiết bị, bố
trí không gian đến tích hợp vận hành. Đảm bảo chất lượng hình ảnh, độ chính xác chẩn đoán và hiệu
suất khai thác thiết bị.

### Giải pháp hồi sức cấp cứu & ICU

Xây dựng giải pháp thiết bị cho khoa hồi sức cấp cứu với hệ thống monitoring, máy thở, thiết bị hỗ
trợ sự sống… đáp ứng yêu cầu điều trị liên tục, chính xác và an toàn cho bệnh nhân.

### Giải pháp nâng cấp & tối ưu hệ thống

Đánh giá hiện trạng và đề xuất phương án nâng cấp, mở rộng hoặc tối ưu hệ thống thiết bị hiện có,
giúp cải thiện hiệu suất hoạt động, kéo dài vòng đời thiết bị và tối ưu chi phí đầu tư.

### Giải pháp tích hợp & chuyển đổi số

Tư vấn và triển khai các giải pháp tích hợp thiết bị với hệ thống quản lý bệnh viện (HIS, RIS,
PACS…), đảm bảo kết nối dữ liệu đồng bộ, hỗ trợ quản lý hiệu quả và nâng cao chất lượng dịch vụ y
tế.

### Giải pháp kỹ thuật & vận hành thiết bị chuyên sâu

Cung cấp giải pháp toàn diện trong quản lý, vận hành, bảo trì và tối ưu hiệu suất cho các hệ thống
thiết bị y tế, đặc biệt là thiết bị chẩn đoán hình ảnh. Đảm bảo thiết bị hoạt động ổn định, duy trì
độ chính xác và giảm thiểu rủi ro gián đoạn.

### Chính hãng 100%

Cam kết phân phối sản phẩm chính hãng từ các nhà sản xuất hàng đầu thế giới. Hồ sơ pháp lý đầy đủ,
bao gồm CO, CQ, giấy phép lưu hành trang thiết bị y tế theo quy định.

### Phản hồi kỹ thuật 24/7

Đội ngũ kỹ thuật chuyên sâu luôn sẵn sàng hỗ trợ 24/7.

### Chuyển giao công nghệ chuyên sâu

HAMEDCO đặc biệt chú trọng chuyển giao công nghệ chuẩn hóa với trọng tâm là đội ngũ kỹ sư được đào
tạo bài bản.

### Bảo hành và bảo trì toàn diện

Chính sách bảo hành chính hãng từ 12 đến 24 tháng. Kế hoạch bảo trì định kỳ và kho linh kiện dự
phòng.

### Hơn 20 năm kinh nghiệm thực chiến

Với hơn 20 năm đồng hành cùng ngành y tế Việt Nam, HAMEDCO thấu hiểu sâu sắc quy trình vận hành và
nhu cầu thực tiễn.

## One platform, endless possibilities

Helix brings together every component of genomic medicine into a single, unified platform.

### Population genomics

Accelerate genomic discoveries and drive real-world clinical impact. Leverage collective genomic
intelligence to advance precision medicine, enhance patient care, and lead in healthcare innovation
with [**Helix Research Network®**][12].

### Clinical testing

Unlock comprehensive genomic insights with [**Helix Diagnostics**][13]. Access the quality genetic
testing you need for your patients faster & easier than ever.

### Research & discovery

Access the largest clinico-genomic database with 13+ years of longitudinal medical records for
research, drug discovery, and clinical trials with [**Helix GenoSphere™**][14].

### Reduce plan costs for genomics

Shift the cost curve and drive growth for health plans with [**Genomic Advantage**][15]™.

> "The most important metric [from these programs is] lives you save, years of life you save...
> We've been able to present it pretty much every month so people can see the benefit."

## Our Services & Solutions

### Data Activation

Our healthcare interoperability platform leverages scalable data integration services to provide
connected and synchronized solutions to meet on-demand needs for providers, health plans, and
government.

[Learn More][143]
[Links logo]

### Quality & Care Management

Our in-clinic and in-hospital population health application combines configurable workflows with
unlimited on-demand registries and reports. Care Teams utilize pre and post planning tools to close
gaps in care and enhance the consumer experience. Quality Teams leverage over 400+ quality measures
and reports to improve performance and drive revenue growth.

[Learn More][144]
[Tracks logo]

### Advanced Interactive Analytics

Our deep analytics platform provides Data Analysts and Leadership Teams strategic insights for
performance improvement. Utilize all data sources and layer attributes for comprehensive analysis
across multiple sites, providers, quality programs, financial classes, health plans, and more
through dynamic dashboards.

[Learn More][145]
[PRiZiM logo]

### Clinical Data Integration

Health Plans leverage clinical data integration to improve quality performance and community health.
Eliminate chart chasing and static EHR patient summaries by using i2i’s Standard Supplemental Data
feeds bi-weekly or monthly with expansive data sets like demographics, SDoH, etc. Share attribution
and care gaps files with provider organizations to close gaps at the point of care versus expensive
Call Center, Case Manager outreach.

[Learn More][146]

## A Population Health Technology Company

* Quality Outcomes
* Care Coordination

Community health technology that delivers better care for all.

### Inspiring Better Care **For a Better Life**

[Request a Demo][142]

### Experience That Matters

We work alongside our customers to accelerate their population health journey for healthier
communities.

#### 23+ Years

Providing Healthcare Technology Solutions & Services

#### 344+ Providers

Clinical Delivery Organization Clients

#### 30+ Payers

Health Plan Clients

#### 36M+ Lives

Medicaid, Medicare, Commercial & Uninsured Health Records

60+ Comprehensive Data Interfaces

#### 3105+ Sites

Facilities Live with i2i Technology

## Our Services & Solutions

### Data Activation

Our healthcare interoperability platform leverages scalable data integration services to provide
connected and synchronized solutions to meet on-demand needs for providers, health plans, and
government.

[Learn More][143]
[Links logo]

### Quality & Care Management

Our in-clinic and in-hospital population health application combines configurable workflows with
unlimited on-demand registries and reports. Care Teams utilize pre and post planning tools to close
gaps in care and enhance the consumer experience. Quality Teams leverage over 400+ quality measures
and reports to improve performance and drive revenue growth.

[Learn More][144]
[Tracks logo]

### Advanced Interactive Analytics

Our deep analytics platform provides Data Analysts and Leadership Teams strategic insights for
performance improvement. Utilize all data sources and layer attributes for comprehensive analysis
across multiple sites, providers, quality programs, financial classes, health plans, and more
through dynamic dashboards.

[Learn More][145]
[PRiZiM logo]

### Clinical Data Integration

Health Plans leverage clinical data integration to improve quality performance and community health.
Eliminate chart chasing and static EHR patient summaries by using i2i’s Standard Supplemental Data
feeds bi-weekly or monthly with expansive data sets like demographics, SDoH, etc. Share attribution
and care gaps files with provider organizations to close gaps at the point of care versus expensive
Call Center, Case Manager outreach.

[Learn More][146]
[CDi logo]

### Providing Measurable
### Population Health Value

### $2.4B

i2i Clients have captured significant dollars through quality/VBC programs, grants, savings, and
avoidable costs

### 5.8

months on average to reach a Return on Investment with i2i solutions & services

### 40

states with i2i clients utilizing our Population Health Technology

### 1 in 3

Medicaid patient records integrated and analyzed by i2i solutions

### Insights from i2i

### Mammoth Hospital expects ROI of approximately $12M

Case Study – Mammoth Hospital achieved a positive ROI with i2i, resulting in over $2 million in
newfound quality revenue and labor savings within just three months post-implementation.

[Download Case Study][147]

### Using Technology To Improve Quality Metrics and Streamline UDS

Listen to our webinar with Crusader Community Health, an FQHC, in Rockford, IL

[Listen to the Webinar][148]

### LifeDoc Health Partners with i2i to Deliver Whole
### Health Program

Read how a Memphis healthcare system uses i2i to manage underserved populations in an advanced whole
health program

[Download Case Study][149]

### Discover The Power of i2i Insight to Innovation

We are investing broadly in practical healthcare technology innovations that will improve our
solutions and services to create a better healthcare system. Our investments support a healthy
ecosystem of smart applications that help providers and health plans improve operations, advance
quality outcomes, and enhance the patient experience.

## **Freaked out about the ACT and the (gasp!) new Digital SAT? Have your sights set on your dream
## school but worried you won’t make the cut?**

If you’re here, we *know* you have the drive to get it done. Now all you need is a mentor who’s been
there/done that, someone who “gets it”— to get you to the finish line.

[ LEARN HOW TO ACE YOUR TEST ][15]
 

## "After 12 years working with hundreds of students in exactly your position, I can tell you it’s
## *not* lack of knowledge that’s keeping you from achieving the score that you want. In fact, you
## *probably already know 90% of the content you need* to ace your college admissions tests.

## What’s holding you back are the parts you can’t *just study away*."

 

# - Kristina Semos

### OWNER / FOUNDER

[800454.jpg]

**Work with founder kristina semos**

[*Read more about Kristina*][16]

 

# IVY LOUNGE PHILOSOPHY:

## Sure there is studying involved, but if you’re not studying the *right* material, not approaching
## it from the *proper* framework, not identifying the gaps in knowledge that you’re too close to
## even see, you can study 24/7 and you’ll never get there.

That’s where we come in. We school you on how to approach the test prep process strategically,
working *smarter*...not harder. (Oh, and by the way, these are also *key* skills you’re going to
need once you actually get in!) Our process helps you get laser focused on what you actually need to
work on to ace the test.

[Untitled-1.jpg]

## **And at Ivy Lounge Test Prep, we’re the ninjas needed to unlock your potential.**

Whether you’re math-phobic, test-phobic, school-phobic, or just a whip-smart achiever who wants to
go further, the first step to success is diagnosing your sticking points and prescribing a solution
specific to you with our:

## As seen in:

## What sets us apart

## Our people make the difference.

Life Line Screening appointments are conducted by a team of technicians that pair clinical precision
with genuine, personal care that doesn’t end with your screening.

## Specialists, not generalists

Our in-house technicians are specially trained in ultrasound imaging, EKG and blood analysis.

## Physician-reviewed

A board-certified physician reviews every result before it reaches you.

## Results you'll understand

We explain what your results mean in plain language. You leave knowing where you stand and what, if
anything, to do about it.

## Why it matters

## Could one screening save your life?

## For tens of thousands of people, it already has.

For 4 out of 5 people who have a stroke, the first symptom is the stroke itself. There’s no warning,
no chance to act, just a single life altering event caused by dangerous plaque buildup, irregular
heart rhythms, and arterial disease.

The vascular ultrasounds we offer aren’t typically available through a routine primary care visit.
We bring them directly to your neighborhood, with no referral needed, no insurance required, and no
months-long wait. Just a clear picture of your cardiovascular risk while there’s still time to do
something about it.

[

### Learn Why Screening Matters

][25]

## The gold standard in wellness screening

## Your heart is where we started. Your whole health is where we are.

We’ve spent 30 years building expertise in cardiovascular and stroke risk, and that’s still at the
heart of everything we do. But your health is a fuller picture than any single system, and we’ve
expanded to meet it.

We offer screenings across the conditions that matter most. Whether you’re starting with one concern
or ready to see the full picture, we’ll help you get there.

## Simplicity from start to finish

## Step 1

## Book near you

Choose from locations across the country — churches, community centers and other local venues. Most
appointments are available within a week. No referral needed, no insurance required.

## Step 2

## Get screened

Your appointment takes about an hour. It’s painless, non-invasive, and handled entirely by trained
specialists. No hospitals, no waiting rooms.

## Step 3

## Get clear results

Your physician-reviewed results are available online within 10 days. If anything needs attention,
you’ll be notified with clear guidance. No guesswork, no jargon.
[

### Book Your Screening

][33]

## Success stories & testimonials

Life Line gives you on the spot answers. It’s cost is affordable. I have done it twice and I will be
doing it again shortly. The staff is friendly and you are not there for a long time. It gets two
thumbs up from me!

## - Marlon, Los Angeles, CA

These screenings give me peace of mind in the areas of Carotid Artery Disease and Peripheral
Arterial Disease. It is a shame the medical industry does not value this type of proactive
investigation into our health.  Thank you Life Line Screening!

## - Lori, Vancouver, WA

I have used Life Line Screening for many years to give my doctor additional info beyond the regular
testing he does.  It helps to make a better assessment of my health.

## - Charles, Unionville, NC

This screening helped save me from the fate of my father and brother, who both died of heart attacks
due to underlying health conditions such as diabetes and high blood pressure. Thank you. Life Line.

## - Dana, Orangeburg, SC

## The best time to get screened is before you wish you did.

The hardest part is deciding to go. We handle everything after that. Packages start at $186.

the confidence that comes from never losing sight of your health.

* **$30** credit toward any screening enhancement
* Live clinical results consultation
* Priority scheduling & no change fees
* Discounted screenings for family members

### Learn More

][32]

## Simplicity from start to finish

## Step 1

## Book near you

Choose from locations across the country — churches, community centers and other local venues. Most
appointments are available within a week. No referral needed, no insurance required.

## Step 2

## Get screened

Your appointment takes about an hour. It’s painless, non-invasive, and handled entirely by trained
specialists. No hospitals, no waiting rooms.

## Step 3

## Get clear results

Your physician-reviewed results are available online within 10 days. If anything needs attention,
you’ll be notified with clear guidance. No guesswork, no jargon.
[

### Book Your Screening

][33]

## Success stories & testimonials

Life Line gives you on the spot answers. It’s cost is affordable. I have done it twice and I will be
doing it again shortly. The staff is friendly and you are not there for a long time. It gets two
thumbs up from me!

## - Marlon, Los Angeles, CA

These screenings give me peace of mind in the areas of Carotid Artery Disease and Peripheral
Arterial Disease. It is a shame the medical industry does not value this type of proactive
investigation into our health.  Thank you Life Line Screening!

## - Lori, Vancouver, WA

I have used Life Line Screening for many years to give my doctor additional info beyond the regular
testing he does.  It helps to make a better assessment of my health.

## - Charles, Unionville, NC

This screening helped save me from the fate of my father and brother, who both died of heart attacks
due to underlying health conditions such as diabetes and high blood pressure. Thank you. Life Line.

## - Dana, Orangeburg, SC

## The best time to get screened is before you wish you did.

The hardest part is deciding to go. We handle everything after that. Packages start at $186.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# Preventive care, delivered differently.

Reperio makes preventive care easy to complete—and easier to act on. We help employers and health
plans activate more people into preventive screenings by bringing the experience home—delivering
instant results, clinician review, and seamless follow-up care in one connected flow.
**✓ Screen at home   **
**✓ Results right away  **
**✓ Clinician consult to ongoing care**
Accepted by major health plans.
[Talk to our team][25][Order ReperioKit™][26]
“By facilitating accessible biometric health screenings for our employees, we're eliminating
barriers and empowering them with real-time insights into their health (...) Through Reperio's
at-home screenings, our employees can take proactive measures to prioritize their wellbeing, moving
beyond outdated methods to embrace a more proactive approach to health and wellbeing management."
“This kit lowers the barrier to accessing biometrics in a fashion I've never seen. It is simple to
use and it's easy to return and it works, the data is immediately available to the end user (...) as
a Medical Director, I'm just ecstatic over our availability to use this [from a population health
standpoint] (...) this is a very sophisticated system."
“[Reperio] ensures every employee can benefit from important preventive tests, no matter their
location or availability, and [everyone] can benefit from the cost
savings of lowering their population health risks.”
“With [Reperio’s] at-home biometric health screenings integrated as a part of our telemedicine
platform, we empower doctors and providers with a next-generation solution to conduct Annual
Wellness Consultations (...) enhancing accessible healthcare for our members all across the
country.”
“The thoroughness of how the app walks you through each step leaves little to no room for error
(...) I’ve had biometric screenings done in person before, and this was quicker and I was more
comfortable doing it at home in a judgment-free zone."
“Preventive screening is a proven weapon to preventing chronic illness. Reperio provides a
world-class experience and reduces the 2 most common friction points of screenings: convenience and
cost.”
“Extremely easy to follow directions, and easy to use. Better than having to go wait in line to get
a blood draw!”
“It’s fast, easy, and gives results immediately (...) I wish I could own one of the kits to use on
myself and family to keep us on track to better health. I love the kit!”
“The ability to perform this testing in the comfort of my own home with timing that worked for me
was convenient and beneficial.”
“It was so easy to use the kit. The videos in the app helped me know what to do and the labels on
everything were very clear and easy to understand.”
“It is simple and straightforward, and eliminates a need to make an appointment somewhere/wait for
results.”
“Extremely easy to follow directions, and easy of use. Better than having to go wait in line to get
a blood draw!”
“Kit was easy to use and more convenient than missing work and going to LabCorp.”
“The in-depth videos made the entire process so easy. It walked me through everything step by step.
I did not have any issues at all.”
“Very easy, appreciate the walk through each step and then seeing the results immediately!”
“Extremely easy to follow directions & came with everything I needed. First time using Reperio and
was very impressed.”

## What Reperio does

Most people skip routine health checkups. That means preventive benefits go unused across much of
your population. 

Reperio delivers at-home preventive screenings with instant results and virtual visits that close
the loop.

The result: higher participation, earlier risk detection, and a clearer path from insight to action.

# Logistik – vom Markt
# aus gedacht!

Unser Unterschied ist der Perspektivwechsel, denn eigentlich sind wir Händler. Im Ursprung, im
Herzen und im Kopf. Und Händler denken vom Markt aus. Deshalb heißt das Ziel: Aus der Kostenstrecke
Logistik endlich eine Verkaufsstrecke in den Markt zu machen.

[ Mehr über SupplyX ][28]

## Worauf kommt es Ihnen an?

Uns kommt es auf Ihre Wünsche an!
Deshalb bieten wir ganz verschiedene Lösungen.

  und erfolgreiche Geschäftsprozesse.]
  ... dass meine Logistik Wachstum unterstützt, statt als Kostenblock auszubremsen.

## Q2 2026 FinCrime Landscape Report | ANZ

Financial crime across Australia and New Zealand is becoming harder to detect as illicit activity
increasingly blends into ordinary financial behaviour and moves across fragmented digital and
cross-border financial channels.

This report focuses on two key themes shaping the ANZ financial crime landscape in Q2 2026: **online
sexual exploitation of children (OSEC)-related financial flows** and **cross-border transaction
laundering**. These typologies exploit low-value remittances, digital banks, e-wallets, payment
gateways, shell corporations, correspondent banking relationships, and fraudulent non-profit
organisations to disguise the movement and origin of illicit funds.

Inside the report, you will find practical scenarios, transaction-level red flags, KYC/CDD
indicators, and recommendations to help financial institutions identify behavioural patterns,
strengthen due diligence, improve cross-border monitoring, and move beyond isolated rule-based
alerts towards connected, pattern-based intelligence.

Download the report to explore the emerging financial crime scenarios shaping Australia and New
Zealand in Q2 2026.

[Q2 2026 FinCrime Landscape Report | ANZ]
FinCrime Reports

## H1 2026 FinCrime Landscape Report | Philippines

The H1 2026 Financial Crime Landscape in the Philippines report examines two major cyber-enabled
financial crime threats: money mule networks and romance scams. It highlights how fraud syndicates
are exploiting digital onboarding, instant payment rails, e-wallets, shell companies, and social
platforms to move illicit funds quickly across institutions.

Developed by experts from the AFC Ecosystem in collaboration with ABCOMP, the report presents
practical scenarios, transaction-level red flags, KYC/CDD risk indicators, and key recommendations
for financial institutions. It also underlines the importance of stronger behavioural detection,
cross-institution collaboration, and faster response mechanisms to close visibility gaps in the
fight against organised financial crime.

Download the report to explore the full scenarios, red flags, and recommendations for strengthening
financial crime controls in the Philippines.

## Q2 2026 FinCrime Landscape Report | ANZ

Financial crime across Australia and New Zealand is becoming harder to detect as illicit activity
increasingly blends into ordinary financial behaviour and moves across fragmented digital and
cross-border financial channels.

This report focuses on two key themes shaping the ANZ financial crime landscape in Q2 2026: **online
sexual exploitation of children (OSEC)-related financial flows** and **cross-border transaction
laundering**. These typologies exploit low-value remittances, digital banks, e-wallets, payment
gateways, shell corporations, correspondent banking relationships, and fraudulent non-profit
organisations to disguise the movement and origin of illicit funds.

Inside the report, you will find practical scenarios, transaction-level red flags, KYC/CDD
indicators, and recommendations to help financial institutions identify behavioural patterns,
strengthen due diligence, improve cross-border monitoring, and move beyond isolated rule-based
alerts towards connected, pattern-based intelligence.

Download the report to explore the emerging financial crime scenarios shaping Australia and New
Zealand in Q2 2026.

[Q2 2026 FinCrime Landscape Report | ANZ]

## H1 2026 FinCrime Landscape Report | Philippines

The H1 2026 Financial Crime Landscape in the Philippines report examines two major cyber-enabled
financial crime threats: money mule networks and romance scams. It highlights how fraud syndicates
are exploiting digital onboarding, instant payment rails, e-wallets, shell companies, and social
platforms to move illicit funds quickly across institutions.

Developed by experts from the AFC Ecosystem in collaboration with ABCOMP, the report presents
practical scenarios, transaction-level red flags, KYC/CDD risk indicators, and key recommendations
for financial institutions. It also underlines the importance of stronger behavioural detection,
cross-institution collaboration, and faster response mechanisms to close visibility gaps in the
fight against organised financial crime.

Download the report to explore the full scenarios, red flags, and recommendations for strengthening
financial crime controls in the Philippines.

## Sustainability leader in our industry

Trelleborg’s products and solutions have unique properties that protect the essential. We are
committed to contributing to a more sustainable development and society, which means taking
responsibility for our environmental and social impact throughout the value chain.  
[Sustainability][29]
[Employees collaborating in a meeting]

## Shaping Industry From the Inside

Trelleborg foster a culture where everyone can thrive and contribute, characterized by clear
leadership and accountability. We believe every employee has the potential to make a meaningful
impact and shape industry from the inside. 

[Meet us][30]

## FAQ
* What does Trelleborg specialize in?
  Trelleborg Group specialize in engineered polymer solutions. We offer a unique solutions portfolio
  for a wide range of applications, including the most complex. Early market insights and broad
  expertise make us a world leader in engineered polymer solutions.
* Which industries does Trelleborg serve?
  Trelleborg serve industries where performance, reliability and sustainability are critical; these
  include aerospace, automotive, medical, energy & renewables, water infrastructure, semiconductor
  manufacturing, food & beverage, and others.
  
  Our solutions protect the essential: people, industrial equipment, infrastructure and the
  environment.
  [Your Industry][32]
* What is Trelleborg’s strategic focus?
  Trelleborg focus on leading positions in selected segments. We make an overall assessment based on
  multiple parameters with highly selective approach, targeting attractive niches and developing
  globally leading positions.
  
* Where does Trelleborg operate?
  Trelleborg operate globally through state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, R&D centers, sales
  offices, and distribution networks. We strive to maintain a strong physical presence close to our
  customers.
* What types of solutions does Trelleborg offer?
  Trelleborg engineers complete polymer-based solutions that enhance performance, efficiency and
  sustainability. Through innovation, application expertise and close customer partnerships, we
  strengthen performance and drive sustainable growth.
  [Our Solutions][33]

## 120-year Anniversary

From our founding to today, Trelleborg has been shaped by innovation, resilience and the people who
made it all possible.
[Join us in honoring the journey][28]
[Wind turbines representing renewable energy and sustainability]

## Sustainability leader in our industry

Trelleborg’s products and solutions have unique properties that protect the essential. We are
committed to contributing to a more sustainable development and society, which means taking
responsibility for our environmental and social impact throughout the value chain.  
[Sustainability][29]
[Employees collaborating in a meeting]

## Shaping Industry From the Inside

Trelleborg foster a culture where everyone can thrive and contribute, characterized by clear
leadership and accountability. We believe every employee has the potential to make a meaningful
impact and shape industry from the inside. 

[Meet us][30]

## Contact Us

Get the expert advice and answers you need within our global group network.
[Contact Trelleborg][31]
[Employees outside Trelleborg headquarters]

## FAQ
* What does Trelleborg specialize in?
  Trelleborg Group specialize in engineered polymer solutions. We offer a unique solutions portfolio
  for a wide range of applications, including the most complex. Early market insights and broad
  expertise make us a world leader in engineered polymer solutions.
* Which industries does Trelleborg serve?
  Trelleborg serve industries where performance, reliability and sustainability are critical; these
  include aerospace, automotive, medical, energy & renewables, water infrastructure, semiconductor
  manufacturing, food & beverage, and others.
  
  Our solutions protect the essential: people, industrial equipment, infrastructure and the
  environment.
  [Your Industry][32]
* What is Trelleborg’s strategic focus?
  Trelleborg focus on leading positions in selected segments. We make an overall assessment based on
  multiple parameters with highly selective approach, targeting attractive niches and developing
  globally leading positions.
  
* Where does Trelleborg operate?
  Trelleborg operate globally through state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, R&D centers, sales
  offices, and distribution networks. We strive to maintain a strong physical presence close to our
  customers.
* What types of solutions does Trelleborg offer?
  Trelleborg engineers complete polymer-based solutions that enhance performance, efficiency and
  sustainability. Through innovation, application expertise and close customer partnerships, we
  strengthen performance and drive sustainable growth.
  [Our Solutions][33]

## **Employers trust Universal Background Screening to Deliver Hire Quality™**

Universal Background provides industry leading people insights to safety sensitive organizations in
a simplified experience through our best-in-class background screening, drug testing, occupational
health, and verification services.

We are proudly ranked as an industry leader in quality and service delivery.

Firm in HRO Today’s 2023 Customer Satisfaction Ratings. [Click here][70] and learn about our
white-glove service.
